events.what_it_is: An immersive Good Girl fragrance pop-up celebrating the scent's 10th anniversary, with fragrance discovery, interactive challenges, prizes, beauty experiences and a Good Girl Café.
events.what_is_free: Admission is free. Interactive activities can yield prizes such as miniatures and makeup services; Carolina Herrera x Myka frozen yogurt is advertised for the first 100 guests.
events.caveats: Free timed reservations are available, but current event information explicitly says walk-ins are allowed based on capacity. Treat this as first-come access with optional RSVP rather than guaranteed admission. Promotional prizes and frozen yogurt are limited.
events.practical_notes: Friday September 11: noon–6 PM; Saturday September 12: 11 AM–6 PM; Sunday September 13: 11 AM–3 PM. Approximate session duration is 40 minutes.

events.address: Madison Square Park, Fifth Ave & Broadway at 23rd St, New York, NY 10010
events.what_it_is: IBM's free US Open Championship Weekend fan hub with AI-powered tennis activations, live match viewing, a serve simulator, AI-enabled ping pong and an AI photo booth.
events.what_is_free: IBM explicitly describes the fan experience as free and open to the public. Activations and live viewing are included; official merchandise is available separately.
events.caveats: No RSVP or approval requirement is published. The activation is outdoors in Madison Square Park, and programming can follow tournament scheduling.
events.practical_notes: Friday September 11: 9 AM–9 PM; Saturday September 12: 11 AM–8 PM; Sunday September 13: 11 AM–7 PM. Located at the southeast corner of Madison Square Park near One Madison Avenue.
